page.layout: One column of entries, each a line in a list of Latin verbs with German glosses. Page number top right, running head "LATINA." top centre. A "(fui." note stands in the right margin beside the Sedeo line.

main_text.l: Mulgeo, ich [?]iehe die milch heraus/ mulsi,mulctū.
Oboleo, ich stinck übel/ ich empfinde/obolevi & obolui,obolitum.
Prandeo,ich esse zu mittage/ prādi & pransus sum.
Polluceo, ich opffere oder halte herlich/ polluxi,
Pendeo, ich hange/ ich zweifele/ pependi, absque
Redoleo, ich riecke nach etwas / redolevi & redo-
Soleo, ich pfleg/ ich bin gewohnt / solitus sum vel
Spondeo, ich verheisse/ ich verspreche/ spopondi,
Torqueo, ich winde umb/ich peinige/ torsi, tortū.
Turgeo , ich bin auffgeblasen/ geschwollen / tursi,

page.notes: The "(fui." in the right margin is a marginal note beside Sedeo; its closing bracket is not visible. The mark "✱" between the Mulgeo and Neo lines is a stray mark or show-through, not text. The German glosses are set in black letter and marked <bl>. Uncertain readings: "siehe" in the Mulgeo gloss and "knirte" in the Strideo gloss are marked [?]. The "&" at the start of the wrapped lines is printed as a hanging continuation mark and is kept.
